# LoopDesk Discount Function build artifact directory

`function.wasm` is generated by Shopify CLI's supported JavaScript Function/Javy build pipeline and is intentionally ignored by git.

For Shopify releases, `shopify app deploy`/`shopify app build` already builds this JavaScript function extension directly because `shopify.extension.toml` omits `[extensions.build].command`. Do not invoke a nested Shopify CLI function build from the extension build step; doing so nests Shopify CLI inside its own function build and can hang releases.

If you need to produce `dist/function.wasm` locally, run `shopify app build` or `shopify app deploy` from the app root with the Shopify Function JavaScript toolchain installed. The build must produce a real Shopify Function-compatible WASM artifact; no placeholder or fallback WASM should be committed.
